test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

You have to see it to believe it.

options.text: It has to be seen to be believed.
It has to be seen to being believed.
It needs to being seen to be believed.
It have to be seen to believe.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It has to be seen to be believed.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While changing the voice of **an infinitive sentence,** we change the verb as follows;

 
 
• **To catch----- To be caught, **
 
• **To help------ to be helped **
 
 
 
• All the other rules remain the same as the other passive voices.
 
• The subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well if subject and object are pronouns.
 
• Always use the third form of the main verb(robbed) in passive form.
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

So, the final sentence is -* It has to be seen to be believed.*
